concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-api-explorer-transfers-latest-post-grants]] — 2026-09-15-captured Transfers API v4 TEST `POST /grants` reference for requesting payout of a selected Capital offer, with grant/status readback; a 200 or Pending grant is not final disbursement or repayment proof, and the 404 payment wording is mismatched.
warnings: The endpoint's 404 description names a payment rather than a grant; do not derive grant-specific not-found behavior from it.
